descriptions.w3d_s20_refresh_item_block_801a5a6c: Appears to refresh an item's 16-byte block from the secondary base subobject after notifying it and dispatching the item's target.
descriptions.w3d_s20_refresh_item_block_801a58d0: Appears to refresh an item's 16-byte block from the secondary base subobject, forwarding to a helper when the item has no target.
